summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 58 (ipns-signature-verify-coverage) of CipherBox using the GSD workflow system, auto-advancing from planning to execution via --chain and --auto flags.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans across 2 waves were successfully planned, executed, and verified. Phase 58 passed 7/7 must-have criteria with all decisions D-01..D-13 confirmed in code, HARD-09 satisfied, and 89/89 SDK E2E tests passing after a targeted fix for the E2E authentication mismatch.

repo: crates/crypto cannot dev-depend on api-client/core, so the Rust cross-language verify vector consumer must live in crates/fuse/tests/ rather than crates/crypto/tests/ to avoid a dependency cycle

The running API at :3000 uses TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only in its .env, but the SDK E2E harness defaults to e2e-test-secret-do-not-use-in-production — these must be aligned for the E2E gate to authenticate
The D-09/sequence tightening class of changes previously broke 48/89 SDK E2E tests; it is a high-risk change category requiring explicit E2E gate validation
replay.rs uses unchecked seq + 1 arithmetic while the rest of the crate uses checked_add — an inconsistency flagged by code review (WR-01)
upsertFolderIpns requires the non-CAS embedded-sequence D-09 gate with an idempotent branch: no-increment but update latestCid for same-sequence republish

code.finding: ciborium is listed in crates/fuse/Cargo.toml (line 43) — the mid-execution diagnostic claiming it was missing was stale state from a partial edit, not a real dependency gap

workflow: Sequential executors on the feature branch are preferable to parallel worktree isolation for delicate multi-crate crypto phases — avoids cwd-drift, merge failures, and stranded worktrees
commit_failed from the GSD commit helper can be a false negative; always verify with git log before retrying or treating as a real failure

When an executor dies mid-task due to a socket error, previously committed work survives intact — a continuation agent can pick up from the last committed state using the uncommitted diff as its starting context
An executor spawned for one plan may continue directly into the next sequential plan in the same run when context and momentum allow — account for this when tracking plan completion state
The RESEARCH.md Open Questions section should carry a (RESOLVED) marker inline once questions are addressed in-plan; missing it triggers a cosmetic plan-checker warning

friction: 58-01 executor died mid-task-4 (FUSE resolve-site routing, 5 files modified but uncommitted) due to an API socket connection close, requiring a separate continuation agent

58-02's full-SDK-E2E gate did not run during plan execution because the executor started the API from compiled dist with a mismatched TEST_LOGIN_SECRET, causing test-login 401s and suite skip — the gate had to be re-run separately post-execution
Probing the :3000 test-login endpoint manually was blocked by an unknown payload shape, requiring a dedicated agent to discover and run the harness correctly
The executor spawned for 58-02 continued into 58-03 in the same run without being asked, making it harder to track per-plan completion state and validate E2E gating per plan
open_items: Apply the 4 advisory code review findings from the parallel review agent: WR-01 (unchecked seq+1 in replay.rs vs checked_add convention) plus 3 robustness/parity improvements in the verification path
Align TEST_LOGIN_SECRET between apps/api/.env and the SDK E2E harness default to prevent silent E2E gate skips in future executor runs
